records.issue_text: Server silently dedupes already-attendee emails and reports 'Guests added' success even when nothing was added
records.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, the server filters out already-attendee/blacklisted emails into `uniqueGuests`, but it does **not** return success when nothing is added: if `uniqueGuests.length === 0` it throws a `TRPCError` (BAD_REQUEST, "emails_must_be_unique_valid") before the DB update. It always returns `{ message: "Guests added" }` only after successfully creating attendees.

records.issue_text: findFirstOrThrow on booking.userId || 0 for team bookings throws an unhandled Prisma record-not-found as a raw 500 instead of a clean TRPC error
